new_claims.statement: For Q0=F_H+F_Y+F_Z+2(s.X)Y1+2(t.X)Z1+2 sigma Y2Z2, Schur's test on the phase-twisted hub kernel gives |phi(tau)|<=pi^(3/2)sqrt(MY MZ)sqrt(Ks Kt)|sigma|^(-1/2)|tau|^(-3/2). For cap-one product hubs and MY,MZ<=2, with R=||s||||t|| |sigma|, int|phi|<=12pi R^(-1/3) and ||p||<=6R^(-1/3), continuously C0.

If the r39 physical L-R block has rank one and all H-L and H-R stars share fixed physical projection directions, then S=sum_h T_h<=R^2, so ||p||<=6S^(-1/6) and int|phi|<=12pi S^(-1/6) without selecting a hub. On S>=(4/3125)V1 this gives 18.2088669301 V1^(-1/6) and 114.409685156 V1^(-1/6).
Combining the new grouped |t|^-3/2 tail with account04/B02's L2 estimate yields ||p||<=7.02699217411 |det H0|^(-1/12)R^(-1/4), hence <=16.1572789749 |det H0|^(-1/12)V1^(-1/8) on the r39 resource.

quantitative_consequences: At V1>1/4 in the coherent-star rank-one two-star branch, ||p||<22.941734740 and int|phi|<144.147170639
The grouped theorem is stable as the two hub coefficient vectors become parallel; no reciprocal joint-projection angle occurs
On the account04/B02 overlap and V1>1/4, ||p||<19.2143511161 |det H0|^(-1/12)
unresolved_implication: The r39 grouped two-star branch remains open when the L-R crossing has rank at least two or the grouped H-L/H-R star matrices are not coherent rank one; the grouped diagonal-pivot alternative is also separate.
